content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 8.2 ("Exclusivity of Efforts") is a Customer-binding exclusive-dealing covenant on Ono, with an uncapped term, a post-termination tail to the [ * ] anniversary, and an immediate Array termination right — failing the fallback (no 12-month cap, no automatic exit on Array performance failure). The Article IX supply provisions are not exclusivity (Ono expressly retains manufacturing/second-source rights under 9.4(a)), and the Section 2.1 exclusive licences run in our favour, so neither was flagged.

The redline (validated, `ok:true`) takes the preferred position: removes Ono and its Affiliates from the covenant, deletes the post-termination restriction and Array's related termination right, keeps Array's reciprocal restriction that benefits us, and conforms the Section 14.2(a)(i) cross-reference so no dangling reference to a Section 8.2 termination survives.
